alt.hero: El Portal de la Quebrada hotel in Tilcara, Jujuy

home.title: Hotel & Spa in Tilcara with Pool | El Portal de la Quebrada
home.description: Hotel and spa in Tilcara, Jujuy, on Route 9, 500 meters from the northern entrance to town. Rooms, pool, spa and restaurant in the Quebrada de Humahuaca.

home.title: Hotel & Spa with views of the Tilcara mountains
home.subtitle: Comfortable rooms, pool, spa and restaurant, 500 meters from the northern entrance to Tilcara, on Route 9.
home.intro_text: Its name comes from the Portada de Antofagasta: just as that monument marks an entrance, this hotel is the gateway to the Quebrada de Humahuaca. Come enjoy the landscapes of northern Argentina and its traditional cuisine.

spa.text: A place to unwind after exploring the Quebrada.

restaurant.text: Traditional northern dishes, with a hall for 200 guests.

home.where_title: On Route 9, 500 meters from the northern entrance to Tilcara
home.where_text: We are on Av. 17 de Octubre, a few minutes from downtown Tilcara and the Pucará.
